scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic derivation of the four branches and unrestricted symmetry averaging; finite exact-rational tests supplement rather than establish the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Only unit-diagonal SPD positive two-community correlation matrices with two communities of at least two coordinates.
Optimality is for sharp fixed iid one-step expected squared-energy contraction under exact single-coordinate minimization.
Global symmetry averaging establishes existence of a block-uniform optimum; uniqueness of all unrestricted optimizers is not claimed.
Historic optimal-design and matrix-scaling literature may have equivalent statements not located in inspected sources.
title: Four-phase optimal coordinate sampling for two-community correlation systems
